name: player-env
title: Player environment hooks
description: Shared hooks for the Lottie player. useInView reports viewport visibility through an IntersectionObserver. useThemeChange fires when data-theme or class changes on the element or any of its ancestors, or when the OS color scheme changes.

name: lottie-player
title: Lottie player
description: A dotLottie player for .lottie and Lottie .json files. It supports autoplay, loop, playOnHover (plays forward on enter and in reverse on leave, and can be interrupted), playOnView, segments and a controlled playing prop. Speed is speed / timeScale. Under reduced motion it shows a poster frame. It pauses offscreen. Color slots bind to youj tokens and re-theme live.

name: lottie-samples
title: Youj Lottie samples
description: Original Lottie JSON animations generated from the youj motion tokens, with color slots named after the color tokens: success-check and an upload-progress loader. The binary logo-sting.lottie isn't included because registry files are text. Copy it from public/samples or regenerate it with scripts/lottie/generate.mjs.
